title: Flange Press
pages: Craft the controller with dispensers, iron blocks and tempered steel from the Quench Vat. Build a five-block cross footing beneath the controller: netherite directly below, iron blocks east and west of that base, and copper blocks north and south. Put a loom directly above the controller and face dispensers inward on its north and south sides, each over a copper saddle. The controller stays reachable from the east and west. Two presses built two blocks apart east/west may share an iron foot; the lower-position controller owns it and the other press stays unformed until that controller is removed. Material update: crafting slot 2 (row-major 3x3) now requires a titanium ingot via forge:ingots/titanium; all existing progression gates remain required.

Right-click the controller with feedstock from a loaded flanging recipe. The press loads one recipe batch into its stock buffer, processes it over 40 ticks, and holds the output for empty-hand collection or bottom-face extraction. A missing footing block, loom lid, or outward/missing side dispenser stops operation.

It runs 21 exclusive datapack flanging recipes, each shown in JEI with its required batch size. Four iron ingots, two annealed copper or one sealed steel plate flange down into a standardized flanged ring, giving every tier of feedstock a hopper-automatable path to this one part. The other rows turn rims and collars into finished hardware at a material cost no lower than hand crafting: seven gold ingots spin into a bell, four iron nuggets roll one iron bar, eighteen gold nuggets press a light weighted pressure plate, six diamonds form diamond horse armor and five tempered steel form iron horse armor. Tag inputs accept any forge:ingots metal of that name: seven tantalum make a cauldron, five titanium a minecart, six zirconium a hopper, thirty-one tungsten an anvil, two nickel a chain, three aluminum a bucket, four chromium an iron trapdoor, six manganese three iron doors and three lead a heavy weighted pressure plate.

Flanged rings hold the Magnetizer's field coil: two of them flank the conductive crystal in the middle row of the Magnetizer controller, with a nickel ingot, redstone and iron above and iron, redstone and iron below. Keep the Flange Press after the Press; the Resonance Infuser cannot be reached without its rings. Bare redstone does not substitute for a ring. One Stainless Vessel Stock instead flanges into an Encoder Ring Blank, the stainless ring later graduated by the Heliostat Etcher for the Rotary Encoder. One Bearing Steel Stock flattens into two Thrust Washer Blanks, which the Quench Vat hardens for the Thrust Ball Bearing under the Prism Separator spindle. One Tool Steel Stock stamps into four Retaining Rings: open external circlips with pierced plier lugs, which seat in shaft grooves to stop a bearing or wheel sliding along it while it still turns. Real circlips are stamped from spring-steel sheet and then hardened; here the stock is already hardened tool steel, so groove depth and thrust load are not simulated. The Lens Grinder needs two to retain its grinding spindle. One Unexpanded Tube Bundle (seven Drawn Copper Tubes threaded through two Sealed Steel Plate tubesheets) is roller-expanded into an Expanded Tube Bundle: each tube end is swelled against its tubesheet hole until the joint seals, which is how real shell-and-tube bundles are fixed. The bundle becomes the core of the Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger that the Noctilucent Condenser needs. The press is hand-fed: hold the listed input count and right-click a formed controller. It has no FE port; formed controllers also hold buffered stock and output for sided item automation.

Automation: place a hopper or item pipe against any input face (all faces except the bottom by default) and feed a loaded recipe input. A formed controller processes one batch every 40 ticks without FE; its bottom face outputs to a hopper or pipe. Empty-hand right-click collects buffered products. Sneak-right-click a face with an empty hand cycles it through input, output and off. Full output pauses processing; broken or unloaded structures do not process. Buffered items and side settings survive saving; breaking the controller drops its buffers.
